content.value_statement: Building reusable AI skills can become inconsistent without clear structure. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through planning, validation, and packaging.
actual_capabilities: Explains the structure of a valid skill folder and required SKILL.md metadata.
Guides planning around workflows, scripts, references, and reusable assets.
Provides a template generator for new skill folders.
Validates skill frontmatter, naming rules, and description constraints.
Packages a completed skill folder into a distributable .skill archive.
limitations: Does not publish skills to a marketplace.
Does not verify business value with real users.
Does not inspect generated assets for licensing issues.
Requires user review of generated examples before distribution.

use_cases.title: New Skill Author
use_cases.description: Create a first Codex skill with required metadata, structure, and validation checks.

use_cases.title: Team Workflow Maintainer
use_cases.description: Convert repeated internal processes into reusable skill instructions and bundled reference files.

use_cases.title: Marketplace Reviewer
use_cases.description: Check whether a submitted skill has coherent structure, useful prompts, and clear resource boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a new Codex skill for [task]. Ask for missing scope, then generate the folder structure.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Reusable Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review [workflow]. Recommend which scripts, references, or assets the skill should include.

prompt_templates.title: Validate an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to audit the skill at [path]. Check metadata, structure, resource references, and validation errors.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Marketplace Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to revise [skill name] for marketplace use. Tighten the trigger description, remove clutter, and test packaging.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for reviewing API change logs.
output_examples.output: A normalized skill name, folder plan, concise trigger description, and recommended reference files.

output_examples.input: Validate this completed skill before sharing it.
output_examples.output: A short validation report with frontmatter issues, naming problems, resource cleanup items, and packaging readiness.
A packaged skill file is created after validation, with clear messages for any problems found.

best_practices: Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed references into separate files.
Run validation before packaging or sharing a skill.
Delete example resources that do not support the final skill.
anti_patterns: Do not add broad reference files that are never loaded for real tasks.
Do not hide trigger details inside the body of SKILL.md.
Do not ship placeholder scripts, assets, or TODO sections.

faq.question: Does this skill create new skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides planning and includes a script that creates a starter skill folder.

faq.question: Can it update an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide edits to SKILL.md and bundled resources.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is relevant to Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it validate skills automatically?
faq.answer: It includes a validator for frontmatter, names, and description rules.

faq.question: Can it package skills for sharing?
faq.answer: Yes. The packager validates the folder, then creates a .skill archive.

faq.question: Does it replace human review?
faq.answer: No. Authors still need to review content quality, safety, and licensing.
